news.title: NBCC signs ₹2,000 crore Patna redevelopment MoUs; Avenue Towers e-auction fetches ₹5,191 crore
news.para: NBCC has signed MoUs with the Bihar government for four redevelopment projects in Patna with an estimated project cost of ₹2,000 crore and potential sale and lease proceeds of about ₹5,152 crore. Separately, the company realised ₹5,191 crore through an e-auction of residential units in New Delhi and opened a branch office in Australia.

news.title: Property owners in Bengaluru face delay in upgrading from B-khata to A-khata due to tech glitches
news.para: In Greater Bengaluru, a noteworthy number of property owners face considerable delays in upgrading from B-khata to A-khata due to technical glitches in the recently implemented e-Aasthi 2.0 software, which hinders document uploads. This has made it increasingly challenging to access essential civic services, conduct transactions, and secure bank loans.

news.title: Sri Lotus Developers promoter to sell up to 5.89% stake through OFS
news.para: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty promoter Anand Kamalnayan Pandit proposes to sell up to 2.88 crore shares, representing 5.89% of the company’s paid-up equity capital, through an offer for sale. The base offer comprises a 4.87% stake, with an additional 1.02% oversubscription option.

news.title: Sebi allows REITs, InvITs to issue depository receipts
news.para: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has authorized the issuance of Depository Receipts for Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) and Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) to increase foreign investment. This new framework allows these investment vehicles to issue fresh units for DRs, mandatory for non-Indian residents, and enforces strict compliance with prior unitholder approval as well as pricing and reporting guidelines.

news.title: Brookfield India REIT’s NOI rises 51% to ₹767.2 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In Q2 FY27, Brookfield India Real Estate Trust achieved a remarkable 51 percent growth in net operating income. Total income soared by over 52 percent year-on-year, and the REIT declared distributions of ₹5.70 per unit. With 1.6 million square feet leased and a solid occupancy rate of 93 percent, the first half of FY27 marked a substantial 54 percent rise in operating lease rentals compared to last year.

news.title: Mindspace Business Parks REIT’s NOI rises 32% to ₹836 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In Q2 FY27, Mindspace Business Parks REIT achieved 31.9 percent rise in net operating income, showcasing its robust financial health. The total income reached ₹1,028.43 crore, marking a 30.1 percent increase year-on-year. Additionally, the net profit saw a jump to ₹479.18 crore. The gross leasing activity was notable, covering around 1.6 million sq ft.

news.title: BirlaNu’s net loss widens 34% to ₹57.37 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: BirlaNu, a subsidiary of the CKA Birla Group, faced a net consolidated loss for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. Despite this, the company saw a rise in total income fueled by revenue increases in its roofs and pipes divisions. The flooring sector, specifically Parador, struggled with declining sales in Europe due to market pressures.

news.title: Puravankara posts ₹83.74 crore net profit in Q2 FY27
news.para: In the second quarter of FY27, Puravankara posted a remarkable consolidated profit after tax of ₹83.74 crore, showcasing an impressive 58.6% rise in total income, which hit ₹1,051.02 crore. Sales value soared by 109% to ₹2,762 crore, fueled by higher handovers and persistent demand. Additionally, customer collections surged 24% to ₹1,301 crore, highlighting a robust market performance.

news.title: EFC (I)’s net profit rises 36% to ₹77.26 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: The company’s consolidated total income increased 33.4 per cent to ₹342.70 crore during the quarter. It also expanded its managed office portfolio in Pune and completed the acquisition of Ultrafresh Modular Solutions.

news.title: Ambuja Cements plans ₹14,500 crore capex to add 30 MTPA capacity
news.para: Ambuja Cements is making a massive investment of ₹14,500 crores to boost its cement production by around 30 million tonnes per annum. This expansion will take place in several states, including Assam, Bihar, Jharkhand, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Uttar Pradesh. By the fiscal year 2030, the company aims to have a total cement capacity of 155 million tonnes per annum.

news.title: Homebuyers body FPCE writes to PM, seeks RERA restructuring to protect consumers
news.para: FPCE has formally urged Prime Minister Modi to propose revisions to the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act. The organization contends that the current legal framework does not adequately protect homebuyers and fails to address widespread unethical practices in the real estate sector. news.title: Structural plan amendments set to ease building restrictions in Kochi’s suburbs
news.para: The Kochi state government has unveiled new amendments to zoning regulations, allowing for mixed land use along designated road corridors. This new approach not only supports residential and commercial development but also updates outdated planning rules. Importantly, provisions protecting agricultural land from flood risks remain intact, balancing growth with safety and sustainability in urban development.

news.title: Goa so far supplied 7.6 lakh tonne waste to cement plants as alternative fuel
news.para: Goa has supplied around 7.6 lakh tonnes of refuse-derived fuel to cement plants, which helps in coal displacement. The collaboration among waste management agencies, urban local bodies, and cement manufacturers is crucial for meeting Solid Waste Management Rules. Significant investments in waste management have improved systems for segregation and processing waste into alternative energy. India’s cement sector recorded a thermal substitution rate of 7.

news.title: Jaipur development body eases approvals for plots freed from power line curbs
news.para: In a bid to simplify procedures for plot owners, the Jaipur Development Authority has introduced a notification enabling applications for approvals and lease deeds to be processed locally. This transition comes on the heels of high-tension lines being removed from multiple colonies, marking an end to the delays that plagued applicants. The revamped approach promises to provide greater efficiency and support for numerous affected stakeholders.

news.title: Patna civic body logs 43% rise in property tax collection
news.para: The Patna Municipal Corporation celebrated a remarkable 43.6% surge in property tax collections over the initial seven months, totaling Rs80.79 crore compared to last year's Rs56.28 crore. To enhance service accessibility, tax collection camps will be set up in various wards. Additionally, in October, 1,398 new properties were successfully included under taxation, showcasing the effectiveness of their outreach strategies which significantly boosted overall collections.

news.title: DivyaSree Developers, HDFC Capital set up ₹1,500 crore residential platform
news.para: DivyaSree Developers and HDFC Capital Advisors have teamed up to create a massive ₹1,500 crore residential development platform. Their goal is to acquire and develop various housing projects over the next three to four years. They’re eyeing projects that could generate ₹6,750 crore in gross development value, making big moves in the real estate market.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh plans ‘Singapore City’ near Noida airport
news.para: The UP government is planning to develop a 'Singapore City' in the YEIDA area to foster investment opportunities. This project aims to utilize Singaporean technology in areas like logistics, semiconductors, and green energy. A delegation of Singaporean industrialists met with Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath to discuss collaboration on this initiative. The development is expected to further enhance the state's electronic manufacturing ecosystem and job creation.

news.title: Bengaluru metro phase-III hits another land hurdle
news.para: In a significant move, the State Government has announced the acquisition of 170 properties for the Orange Line project, vital for establishing metro stations and their essential infrastructure. Delays in acquiring previously identified properties risk inflating costs and disrupting timelines. Officials are being urged to accelerate the land acquisition and tendering processes, while transport experts stress the importance of setting firm deadlines and active monitoring to prevent financial overruns.

news.title: Telangana housing board to hold online lottery for Indiramma Towers beneficiaries on November 3
news.para: On November 3, the Telangana housing board is set to host an online lottery to select beneficiaries for Indiramma Towers. A follow-up mop-up lottery will take place on November 4 to allocate any remaining vacant units from earlier rounds. The e-lottery aims to provide transparency, with live social media broadcasts allowing the public to witness the process.

news.title: All 300 pending high-rise projects get Kolkata civic body's construction go-ahead
news.para: Kolkata's high-level committee has sanctioned the continuation of halted housing developments after thorough safety evaluations and assurances from builders. Of the 300 projects assessed, 178 successfully met established safety benchmarks. As a result, restrictions on constructions of up to five stories have been eased, while vigilant supervision will ensure that safety standards are strictly followed for ongoing high-rise projects.
